claims.claim: The maintained domain/oracle/benchmark substrate on main is the repository's accepted internal comparator for Connect4 solver qualification.
claims.falsifier: The accepted authority or qualification contracts are superseded, or maintained qualification checks fail.
limitations: Repository authority is not by itself an independent external oracle or third-party reproduction.

claims.claim: IsoMax matches the W/D/L class implied by externally sourced Pascal Pons parent-position scores for 128 deterministic Test_L3_R1/Test_L2_R1 calibration positions and 30 explicitly nonrepresentative beginning-position spot checks from Test_L1_R1/Test_L1_R2.
claims.status: 158 tested; 158 matched; 0 mismatches (128 deterministic calibration + 30 nonrepresentative spot checks)
claims.oracle: Pascal Pons Connect Four benchmark parent scores, re-fetched from pinned public mirror megakilo/alphafour revision cf2d4546e5824c155e9dd7e888a572bff3128498
claims.falsifier: Any tested position whose exact IsoMax P0-relative W/D/L differs from the parity/sign-transformed external Pons parent score rejects the scoped claim.
limitations: The 128 L2/L3 positions are deterministic first-64-row calibration subsets.
The 30 L1 positions are deliberately nonrepresentative spot checks selected by an earlier bounded per-move-oracle generation cap.
Does not validate Pons distance-to-win score magnitude.
Does not externally validate repository-generated per-move score vectors.
Does not establish comparative performance superiority or third-party reproduction.
Does not establish CUDA-BSFP external correctness.

claims.claim: Broad active-solver correctness/performance, including comparative performance and other solver families, has independent external validation.
claims.falsifier: Any incorrect solved-position result, incomparable workload, missing provenance, or contradictory independent reference result rejects the corresponding claim.
limitations: IsoMax now has scoped reference-grounded parent-WDL correctness on 158 tested Pons positions (128 deterministic calibration plus 30 nonrepresentative beginning spot checks); comparative performance, other solver families, broader unbiased beginning-position coverage, and third-party reproduction remain separate open claims.
